test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: The simple interest accrued in 2 years on a principal of Rs 24,000 is one-eighth of the principal. What is the rate of simple interest percent per annum?
solution:
Given that the simple interest is one-eighth of the principal,

⇒ S.I. = (1/8)P = (1/8) × 24,000 = Rs 3,000

We know that, formula:

S.I. = frac{{P times R times T}}{{100}}

Where,

S.I. = Simple Interest

P= principal

T = Time

R = Rate of interest

According to the question,

Rate of interest = (S.I. × 100)/(P × t)

⇒ r = {(3000 × 100)/(24000 × 2)}% = 6.25% per annum.

Hence, the required rate of interest per annum is 6.25% per annum.
